story_entries.text: Clinic call notes. I first treated translating for my grandmother like just repeating words. After a volunteer at the clinic told me I was moving too fast, I changed my approach. I started stopping after each part of the call, checking what she understood, and the whole call got calmer.

current_draft.text: This essay should connect translation advocacy to service, empathy, and future direction in medicine. I am trying to frame the experience around values, voice, and the broader meaning of care.
